description: Generic Dual Hat cross-product technical-debt record contract (see dual-hat/planning/TECHNICAL_DEBT.md). This is an aspirational target contract, not a description of any specific product's live implementation: a product's own actual records may key on a different identifier than 'id', carry a different field set than severity/priority/remediation_trigger, and use a different status vocabulary than the proposed/accepted/scheduled/in_progress/blocked/resolved/superseded/rejected enum below. No code path in this repository loads this file or validates any record against it. Do not assume a product's technical-debt records conform to this schema without checking that product's own governance protocol and live backlog for its real, enforced shape.
